Question
========
Which loop construct is generally used in Python to repeat an action for each element in a sequence?

Answerlist
-----------
* while loop only
* for … in … loop
* repeat … until loop
* loop …
* do … while loop
* foreach … in … 

Solution
========
Python’s `for … in …` loop iterates through each element of a sequence.
